Item 1. Business

Section note 500. The following table and discussion compare results for the fiscal years presented, with amounts shown in millions of dollars unless otherwise stated. Our reportable segments are organized by product line and by geographic region, and the chief operating decision maker reviews segment operating income on a quarterly basis. Changes in foreign currency exchange rates affected reported amounts, and the effect is described where it was material to the comparison. Inventory, receivables and payables balances are presented at period end, and cash flow amounts are presented for the full fiscal year. Certain prior period amounts have been reclassified to conform to the current presentation, which had no effect on reported net income or total equity.
